suspend.title: Suspend
suspend.text: The school becomes read only: no new attempts, no review, no edits, AI is not paid by the school. It closes by itself after 30 days; reactivate returns it.

reactivate.title: Reactivate
reactivate.text: The school is active again, as before the suspension.

close.title: Close at once
close.text: Skips the 30 days: staff lose their roles, the subscription is cancelled, courses become unmaintained. The archive lasts 6 months; only a super can restore it.

restore.title: Restore from the archive
restore.text: The school is active again. The subscription is not returned: assign a plan by hand.

purge.title: Purge now
purge.text: Deletes the school’s materials, roster and settings at the next timer run; only the tombstone stays. Students keep their history. Cannot be undone once it has run.
